تنها چیزی که می‌خواهم کمی آرامش است.
What I need it is a long holiday.
What I need is a long holiday.
بعد از What ... مستقیم is؛ it اضافه است.
It was my father who he taught me to swim.
It was my father who taught me to swim.
بعد از who ضمیر تکرار نمی‌شود.
What I want to do it is travel.
What I want to do is travel.
It was my sister who she found the keys.
It was my sister who found the keys.
بعد از who ضمیر تکرار نمی‌شود.
q: It was Sara ___ told me the news.
___ I need is a cup of tea.
It was in Paris ___ they first met.
The reason I'm late is ___ my car broke down.
It's your attitude ___ I don't like.
___ I want is some peace and quiet.
It was my sister who ___ the cake.
lessons.title: تأکید با It was ... who و What I need is
lessons.sum: برای تأکید روی یک بخش جمله: It is / was ... who / that ...، What ... is ...، و the reason is that.

b: دو جمله با یک فاعل را می‌شود کوتاه کرد: فاعل و فعل کمکی جمله‌ی اول حذف می‌شوند و فعل ‎-ing می‌گیرد.
While I was walking home, I met Ali.
Because she felt tired, she went to bed.
Feeling tired, she went to bed.
Walking along the beach, we found a small shell.
در حال قدم زدن در ساحل، صدف کوچکی پیدا کردیم.
Not knowing what to say, he left the room.
چون نمی‌دانست چه بگوید، از اتاق بیرون رفت.
Having + شکل سوم = «بعد از اینکه ... کرده بود»
Having finished her work, she went home.
بعد از تمام کردن کارش به خانه رفت.
Having lived abroad for years, he speaks three languages.
چون سال‌ها خارج زندگی کرده، سه زبان حرف می‌زند.
Built in 1900, the house needs a lot of repairs.
این خانه که سال ۱۹۰۰ ساخته شده، تعمیر زیادی لازم دارد.
Asked about the accident, he said nothing.
وقتی درباره‌ی تصادف از او پرسیدند، چیزی نگفت.
بعد از after / before / while / since
بعد از after، before، while و since می‌شود فعل ‎-ing آورد. فعل ساده نمی‌آید.
After finishing the work, I went home.
بعد از تمام کردن کار به خانه رفتم.
Before leaving the house, check the windows.
قبل از بیرون رفتن از خانه پنجره‌ها را چک کن.
While cooking dinner, she listened to the radio.
موقع پختن شام به رادیو گوش می‌داد.
یک اشتباه ظریف: فاعل باید یکی باشد
فاعلِ بخش ‎-ing همان فاعل جمله‌ی اصلی است. Walking home, the rain started یعنی «باران داشت پیاده به خانه می‌رفت»! درستش: While I was walking home, it started to rain.
While I was walking home, it started to rain.
داشتم به خانه می‌رفتم که باران گرفت.
After finish the work, I went home.
After finishing the work, I went home.
Before leave the house, check the windows.
Before leaving the house, check the windows.
Having finish the report, she left.
Having finished the report, she left.
While read a book, she fell asleep.
While reading a book, she fell asleep.
q: ___ his homework, he went out to play.
بعد از تمام شدن ← having + شکل سوم.
___ in 1850, the bridge is still in use.
After ___ the film, we went for dinner.
___ tired, I went to bed early.
___ what to do, she called her mother.
___ by the noise, the baby started to cry.
lessons.title: جمله‌ی کوتاه‌شده با ‎-ing و شکل سوم (Having finished ...)
lessons.sum: Walking home, I ... / Having finished, she ... / Built in 1900, the house ...: کوتاه کردن جمله با ‎-ing، having + شکل سوم و شکل سوم.

b: مجهول بعد از فعل‌ها و حرف اضافه
I don't like being told what to do.
Having been warned, we took care.
بدم می‌آید حرفم را قطع کنند.
همه دوست دارند دوستشان داشته باشند.
The work should have been finished yesterday.
The letter must have been sent to the wrong address.
نامه حتماً به آدرس اشتباه فرستاده شده.
وقتی فاعل یک چیز است: need + ‎-ing یا need to be + شکل سوم.
The windows need to be cleaned.
He got hurt in the match.
make در جمله‌ی معلوم to نمی‌گیرد (They made him wait)، ولی در مجهول to می‌گیرد: He was made to wait. به جای let در مجهول be allowed to می‌آید.
He was made to wait for two hours.
مجبورش کردند دو ساعت منتظر بماند.
We weren't allowed to take photos.
My car needs to be repaired.
فاعل چیز است ← need to be + شکل سوم.
He was made do the work again.
He was made to do the work again.
I don't like being tell what to do.
I don't like being told what to do.
The work should have been finish yesterday.
The work should have been finished yesterday.
q: I hate ___ in front of other people.
مجهول بعد از hate ← being + شکل سوم.
The report should have ___ last week.
She was made ___ the whole story again.
We weren't ___ to use our phones.
lessons.title: مجهول پیشرفته (being done، needs repairing، get)
lessons.sum: مجهول با ‎-ing و to (being told، to be invited)، مجهول گذشته‌ی فعل‌های وجهی، need + ‎-ing، get + شکل سوم و make / let در مجهول.

b: «وقتش است (دیگر دیر شده)»: It's time + فاعل + فعل گذشته، با اینکه منظور الان است. یا ساده‌تر: It's time to + فعل.
دیگر وقت رفتن به خانه است.
It's high time you found a job.
دیگر واقعاً وقتش است کار پیدا کنی.
I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
Would you rather I came tomorrow?
اگر واقعاً ممکن است، حال می‌آید؛ اگر غیرواقعی است، گذشته.
He talks as if he knew everything.
طوری حرف می‌زند انگار همه‌چیز را می‌داند.
It looks as if it's going to rain.
Suppose you lost your passport. What would you do?
فرض کن پاسپورتت را گم کنی؛ چه کار می‌کنی؟
suggest / insist / demand that + فعل ساده
در انگلیسی رسمی بعد از suggest، recommend، insist، demand و It is essential that فعل ساده برای همه‌ی فاعل‌ها می‌آید (بدون ‎-s)، یا should + فعل.
The doctor recommended that he take a rest.
It is essential that everyone be on time.
ضروری است همه سر وقت باشند.
They insisted that she should stay for dinner.
I'd rather you don't smoke here.
I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
It's high time you find a job.
It's high time you found a job.
q: I'd rather you ___ the window. It's cold.
He acts as if he ___ the boss.
It's high time you ___ to bed.
The teacher suggested that he ___ harder.
___ you had a million dollars. What would you buy?
It's time ___. The film starts at eight.
Would you rather I ___ you tomorrow?
lessons.title: گذشته‌ی غیرواقعی (It's time we went، as if)
lessons.sum: بعد از It's time، would rather + کسی، as if و suppose فعل گذشته برای الان؛ و suggest / insist that + فعل ساده.

b: stop to smoke = ایستادن برای سیگار کشیدن
remember locking = یادم هست قفل کردم (گذشته)
remember to lock = یادم باشد قفل کنم
never forget meeting = هرگز فراموش نمی‌کنم که دیدم
forget to call = یادم رفت زنگ بزنم
try opening = امتحان کن ببین جواب می‌دهد
try to open = سعی کن (سخت است)
regret to tell = متأسفم که باید بگویم (رسمی)
go on talking = ادامه دادن همان کار
go on to become = بعد رفت سراغ کار بعدی
I remember locking the door, but it's open now.
یادم هست در را قفل کردم، ولی الان باز است.
Remember to lock the door when you leave.
یادت باشد موقع رفتن در را قفل کنی.
We stopped to buy some water.
I'll never forget meeting you for the first time.
اولین دیدارمان را هرگز فراموش نمی‌کنم.
If the door won't open, try pushing it harder.
اگر در باز نمی‌شود، محکم‌تر هلش بده ببین چه می‌شود.
I regret telling him my secret.
پشیمانم که رازم را به او گفتم.
It's no use crying about it.
I couldn't help laughing at his joke.
There's no point in waiting any longer.
I'll never forget to meet you.
q: I remember ___ him at a party years ago.
He stopped ___ when he became ill.
We stopped ___ a coffee on the way.
I couldn't help ___ when I saw his face.
There's no point ___ about it now.
I regret ___ so rude to her.
lessons.title: فعل‌هایی که با to و ‎-ing معنی‌شان عوض می‌شود
lessons.en: Verbs with -ing or to: a change in meaning
lessons.sum: stop، remember، forget، try، regret و go on با ‎-ing یک معنی دارند و با to یک معنی دیگر؛ و can't help / no use / no point + ‎-ing.

b: I was going to call you, but I forgot.
I was about to leave when he arrived.
He left Iran in 1990. He would never return.
She was to become a famous writer.
I was going to tell you, but I didn't have time.
می‌خواستم بهت بگویم، ولی وقت نشد.
We were about to eat when the phone rang.
داشتیم غذا می‌خوردیم که تلفن زنگ زد.
They met in 2010. Five years later they would get married.
سال ۲۰۱۰ همدیگر را دیدند. پنج سال بعد ازدواج کردند.
be about to / be on the point of = «همین الان می‌خواهد ...»
Hurry up! The train is about to leave.
عجله کن! قطار الان حرکت می‌کند.
She was on the point of giving up when she found the answer.
نزدیک بود ول کند که جواب را پیدا کرد.
be bound to / be likely to / be due to
The plane is due to land at six.
Don't worry, you're bound to find a job.
نگران نباش، حتماً کار پیدا می‌کنی.
The meeting is likely to finish late.
The new bridge is due to open next month.
پل جدید قرار است ماه بعد باز شود.
I was about to leaving when he arrived.
I was about to leave when he arrived.
She was on the point to give up.
She was on the point of giving up.
The plane is due to landing at six.
The plane is due to land at six.
q: I was ___ call you, but my phone died.
We were about to ___ when it started to rain.
Take a coat. It's ___ to get cold tonight.
The train is ___ to arrive at 9:15.
He's so talented. He's ___ to succeed.
She was on the point ___ the job when they offered her more money.
They married in 1980. They ___ live together for fifty years.
Sit down, the film is about ___.
lessons.title: آینده در گذشته و «احتمالاً» (was about to، be bound to)
lessons.en: Future in the past; likely, bound, due, about to
lessons.sum: was going to / was about to / would برای برنامه‌ای در گذشته، و be about to / bound to / likely to / due to برای آینده.

b: In addition to / As well as / Besides
In addition to teaching, he writes books.
The flat is big. Moreover, it's close to the metro.
آپارتمان بزرگ است. به‌علاوه، نزدیک مترو است.
In addition to speaking English, she speaks Arabic.
علاوه بر انگلیسی، عربی هم حرف می‌زند.
Besides being expensive, the hotel was dirty.
هتل گذشته از گران بودن، کثیف هم بود.
Cities are exciting. On the other hand, they are noisy.
I like tea, whereas my wife prefers coffee.
It was hard. Nevertheless, we finished.
«برعکس»، برای رد حرف قبلی: I'm not tired. On the contrary, I feel great.
Living in a city is exciting. On the other hand, it can be stressful.
زندگی در شهر هیجان دارد. از طرف دیگر، می‌تواند پراسترس باشد.
The test was difficult. Nevertheless, most students passed.
امتحان سخت بود. با این حال بیشتر دانش‌آموزها قبول شدند.
The roads were icy. Therefore, the school was closed.
جاده‌ها یخ زده بود؛ بنابراین مدرسه تعطیل شد.
He didn't study. As a result, he failed.
درس نخواند و در نتیجه رد شد.
فارسی «به نظر من» می‌گوید. انگلیسی according to me نمی‌گوید؛ according to برای نظر یا حرف دیگران است.
In my opinion, the film was too long.
به نظر من فیلم زیادی طولانی بود.
As far as I'm concerned, it's a waste of time.
از نظر من وقت تلف کردن است.
According to the report, prices will rise.
In addition to learn English, he studies French.
In addition to learning English, he studies French.
In the other hand, it is cheap.
On the other hand, it is cheap.
According to me, it is wrong.
In my opinion, it is wrong.
برای نظر خودت in my opinion.
q: The job is well paid. ___, it's interesting.
___ to cooking, he also cleans the house.
I love the sea, ___ my brother prefers the mountains.
It was raining. ___, we went for a walk.
___ my opinion, the plan won't work.
He missed the bus. ___, he was late for work.
___ the other hand, the flat is very small.
___ the news, the road is closed.
lessons.title: کلمه‌های ربط در نوشته (moreover، whereas، on the other hand)
lessons.sum: برای اضافه کردن، مقایسه، نتیجه و نظر: moreover، in addition to + ‎-ing، on the other hand، therefore، as far as I'm concerned.

b: So do I / Neither do I = «من هم»
«من هم» در جمله‌ی مثبت: So + فعل کمکی + فاعل. در جمله‌ی منفی: Neither / Nor + فعل کمکی + فاعل. فعل کمکی از جمله‌ی قبل می‌آید.
"I went to bed late." "So did I."
در محاوره Me too و Me neither هم درست است.
I think so / I hope not
«فکر کنم آره» = I think so (نه I think yes).
I don't like this shirt. Can I see the blue one?
این پیراهن را دوست ندارم. آبی‌اش را می‌شود ببینم؟
These shoes are too small. I need bigger ones.
این کفش‌ها کوچک‌اند؛ بزرگ‌ترش را لازم دارم.
حذف بعد از فعل کمکی و to
I wanted to go, but I wasn't able to.
I am tired. So do I.
I am tired. So am I.
جمله‌ی قبل am دارد ← So am I.
I don't like fish. Neither I do.
I don't like fish. Neither do I.
q: "I didn't see the match." "___ did I."
This cup is dirty. Can I have a clean ___?
lessons.title: کوتاه جواب دادن (So do I، I think so، one)
lessons.sum: برای تکرار نکردن: So do I / Neither can I، I think so / I hope not، one / ones، و do so.

b: در انگلیسی رسمی، بعد از بعضی صفت‌ها و فعل‌هایی که «لازم بودن» یا «خواستن» را می‌رسانند، فعل بعد از that شکل ساده دارد: بدون ‎-s، بدون will و حتی برای be همان be.
It's essential / vital / crucial / important that
It's essential that he be on time.
I suggest that she take a break.
It is essential that every child learn to read.
ضروری است که هر بچه‌ای خواندن یاد بگیرد.
The doctor recommended that she stay in bed.
دکتر توصیه کرد در رختخواب بماند.
I suggest that he apply for the job.
پیشنهاد می‌کنم برای آن کار درخواست بدهد.
در انگلیسی بریتانیایی should هم رایج است: I suggest that he should apply. ولی will نمی‌آید.
منفی‌اش فقط با not است، بدون don't / doesn't.
It is important that he not be late.
They asked that we not make any noise.
خواستند که سر و صدا نکنیم.
I can work at the weekend if need be.
اگر لازم شد، آخر هفته هم کار می‌کنم.
It is essential that he will be on time.
It is essential that he be on time.
بعد از essential that فعل ساده، بدون will.
It is vital that she will take the medicine.
It is vital that she take the medicine.
بعد از vital that فعل ساده.
They demanded him to leave the country.
They demanded that he leave the country.
The doctor insisted him to rest.
The doctor insisted that he rest.
q: It is essential that he ___ here by nine.
I suggest that she ___ a doctor.
بعد از suggest that ← فعل ساده.
They demanded that the company ___ the money back.
It's important that he ___ late again.
The teacher recommended that we ___ more.
I'll stay at the office all night if need ___.
It is vital that everyone ___ the rules.
She insisted that he ___ with us.
lessons.title: فعل ساده بعد از It's essential that و suggest that
lessons.sum: بعد از It's essential / vital that و suggest / demand / insist that فعل ساده می‌آید، برای همه‌ی فاعل‌ها: that he be، that she go.

b: کاری در گذشته انجام نشد و نتیجه‌اش الان دیده می‌شود. بخش if مثل شرطی سوم (had + شکل سوم) و بخش دوم مثل شرطی دوم (would + فعل ساده).
I would be a doctor now.
If she had taken the job,
she would live in London today.
If I hadn't missed the bus,
I would be at home now.
If I had saved some money, I would have a car now.
اگر پول پس‌انداز کرده بودم، الان ماشین داشتم.
If he hadn't lost his keys, he wouldn't be outside now.
اگر کلیدهایش را گم نکرده بود، الان بیرون نمانده بود.
یک ویژگی همیشگی (الان هم هست) نتیجه‌ای در گذشته داشته. بخش if مثل شرطی دوم و بخش دوم مثل شرطی سوم.
If I were braver, I would have told him the truth.
اگر شجاع‌تر بودم، حقیقت را به او گفته بودم.
If she didn't love him, she wouldn't have married him.
اگر دوستش نداشت، با او ازدواج نکرده بود.
If it hadn't been for you, ... (گذشته)
Had it not been for you, ...
If it weren't for my family, I would be very lonely.
اگر خانواده‌ام نبودند، خیلی تنها بودم.
Had it not been for the rain, we would have won.
If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I had saved money, I would have had a car now.
If I had saved money, I would have a car now.
If I didn't lose my keys yesterday, I would be at home now.
If I hadn't lost my keys yesterday, I would be at home now.
شرط در گذشته (yesterday) ← had + شکل سوم.
If she didn't miss the train last night, she would be here now.
If she hadn't missed the train last night, she would be here now.
q: If I had gone to bed earlier, I ___ so tired now.
If he ___ the exam last year, he would be at university now.
If I were more careful, I ___ that mistake yesterday.
___ it not for your help, I would still be lost.
___ it not been for the doctor, he would have died.
گذشته ← Had it not been for.
If we had bought that house, we ___ rich today.
If she ___ afraid of flying, she would have come with us.
If it ___ for my teacher, I wouldn't speak English now.
lessons.title: شرطی ترکیبی (If I had studied, I would be ... now)
lessons.sum: وقتی شرط در گذشته است و نتیجه الان (یا برعکس): If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.

b: Not until / Only when / Only after / Only by
این‌ها یک بخش کامل (یک جمله‌ی کوچک یا یک عبارت) دارند. جابه‌جایی در جمله‌ی اصلی بعد از آن اتفاق می‌افتد، نه بلافاصله.
I noticed the mistake only when I got home.
Only when I got home did I notice the mistake.
I didn't understand until she explained.
Not until she explained did I understand.
You can succeed only by working hard.
Only by working hard can you succeed.
Not until the next morning did we hear the news.
تا صبح روز بعد خبر را نشنیدیم.
Only after the meeting did I realize my mistake.
تازه بعد از جلسه اشتباهم را فهمیدم.
Only by asking questions can you learn.
فقط با سؤال پرسیدن می‌شود یاد گرفت.
Not once / In no way / On no account / Nowhere
Not once did he say thank you.
In no way am I responsible for this.
من به هیچ وجه مسئول این نیستم.
On no account should you leave the door open.
به هیچ عنوان نباید در را باز بگذاری.
Nowhere have I seen such kindness.
So + صفت + فعل + فاعل + that. و Such + be + اسم + that.
So tired was I that I fell asleep at once.
آن‌قدر خسته بودم که فوراً خوابم برد.
So beautiful was the view that nobody spoke.
منظره آن‌قدر زیبا بود که کسی حرف نزد.
Such was his anger that he couldn't speak.
خشمش آن‌قدر زیاد بود که نمی‌توانست حرف بزند.
این ساختارها ادبی و رسمی‌اند؛ در حرف زدن روزمره کمتر به کار می‌روند.
Not until I got home I noticed the mistake.
Not until I got home did I notice the mistake.
بعد از Not until ... ← did I notice.
Only when she left I understood the truth.
Only when she left did I understand the truth.
بعد از Only when ... ← did I understand.
Only by working hard you can succeed.
Only by working hard can you succeed.
بعد از Only by ... ← can you.
Not once he said thank you.
Not once did he say thank you.
بعد از Not once ← did he say.
In no way I am responsible for this.
In no way am I responsible for this.
بعد از In no way ← am I.
So tired I was that I fell asleep at once.
So tired was I that I fell asleep at once.
q: Not until I read the letter ___ the truth.
بعد از Not until ... ← did I know.
Only by practising every day ___ improve.
بعد از Only by ... ← can you.
بعد از Not once ← did she ask.
___ was the noise that we couldn't sleep.
بعد از In no way ← are you.
Only after he had left ___ how much I missed him.
بعد از Only after ... ← did I realize.
بعد از On no account ← should you.
lessons.title: جابه‌جایی پیشرفته (Not until ... did I، So tired was I)
lessons.sum: Not until / Only when / Only by ... در اول جمله، و Not once، In no way، So + صفت + فعل + فاعل.

b: ساختارهای ادبی برای «با اینکه / هرچقدر هم». در جمله‌ی دوم but نمی‌آید.
Much as I like him, I don't trust him.
Strange as it may seem, I enjoy the rain.
Try as I might, I couldn't open the door.
Much as I love my job, I need a holiday.
با اینکه کارم را خیلی دوست دارم، به تعطیلات نیاز دارم.
Tired as she was, she kept working.
با اینکه خسته بود، به کار ادامه داد.
Try as he might, he couldn't remember her name.
هرچه تلاش کرد، اسمش یادش نیامد.
«هرچقدر هم سخت» = however hard یا no matter how hard. much بین how و صفت نمی‌آید.
However hard you try, you can't please everyone.
هرچقدر هم تلاش کنی، نمی‌توانی همه را راضی کنی.
No matter how tired I am, I always read before bed.
هرچقدر هم خسته باشم، قبل از خواب کتاب می‌خوانم.
how much فقط قبل از اسم غیرقابل شمارش (how much money) یا وقتی خودش تنهاست (How much is it?) می‌آید.
Even though it was late, we went for a walk.
با اینکه دیر بود، رفتیم قدم بزنیم.
I like tea, whereas my sister prefers coffee.
من چای دوست دارم، در حالی که خواهرم قهوه را ترجیح می‌دهد.
«با اینکه» جلوی جمله even though است؛ even تنها دو جمله را به هم وصل نمی‌کند.
Much as I like him, but I don't trust him.
Much as I like him, I don't trust him.
بعد از Much as ... but نمی‌آید.
Try as I might, but I couldn't open the door.
Try as I might, I couldn't open the door.
بعد از Try as I might ... but نمی‌آید.
No matter how much hard you try, you can't please everyone.
No matter how hard you try, you can't please everyone.
How much expensive is this phone?
Even I studied hard, I failed the exam.
Even though I studied hard, I failed the exam.
q: ___ as I like the city, I couldn't live there.
Try as she ___, she couldn't find the key.
___ hard he works, he never earns enough.
No matter ___ busy you are, call your mother.
___ it was raining, we played football.
Strange ___ it may seem, I like the winter.
I prefer the sea, ___ my husband loves the mountains.
Much as I admire her, ___ I don't agree with her.
بعد از Much as ... but نمی‌آید.
lessons.title: «هرچقدر هم ...» (Much as I like him، Try as I might)
lessons.sum: Much as / Try as I might / صفت + as + it is، no matter how / however + صفت، و even though (نه even).

b: needn't have و didn't need to
هر دو یعنی «لازم نبود». ولی needn't have + شکل سوم یعنی کار را کردیم و بعد معلوم شد لازم نبود. didn't need to معمولاً یعنی کار را نکردیم چون لازم نبود.
غذا پختم، ولی لازم نبود (کسی گرسنه نبود).
لازم نبود غذا بپزم (و احتمالاً نپختم).
You needn't have brought a present.
We didn't need to wait, so we went in.
لازم نبود منتظر بمانیم، پس رفتیم تو.
بعد از needn't و dare not فعل ساده می‌آید، بدون to.
may well / might well + فعل ساده
The bus isn't coming. We might as well walk.
اتوبوس نمی‌آید. بهتر است پیاده برویم.
خیلی ممکن است حق با او باشد.
احتمال زیاد دارد بعداً باران بیاید.
The president is to visit Iran next month.
قرار است رئیس‌جمهور ماه بعد به ایران سفر کند.
You are to stay in your room until I come back.
باید تا برگشتنم در اتاقت بمانی.
I would have liked to see the museum.
دلم می‌خواست موزه را ببینم (ولی نشد).
بعد از needn't فعل ساده بدون to.
We might as well to take a taxi.
We might as well take a taxi.
He may well to be right.
I dare not to tell him.
q: You needn't ___ me. I can do it myself.
We ___ bought so much food. Nobody came.
خریدیم و لازم نبود ← needn't have.
There's nothing on TV. We might as well ___ to bed.
She may well ___ the job. She's very good.
The meeting ___ to start at ten.
I ___ to come, but I was ill.
I dare not ___ her the truth.
We ___ to take a taxi because Ali gave us a lift.
لازم نشد و نگرفتیم ← didn't need to.
lessons.title: فعل‌های کمکی پیشرفته (needn't have، might as well، be to)
lessons.sum: needn't have done و didn't need to، might as well، may well، dare، و be to برای برنامه و دستور.

b: اسم کلی و انتزاعی بدون the
فارسی‌زبان‌ها زیاد می‌گویند The life is ... . وقتی درباره‌ی چیزی به طور کلی حرف می‌زنیم، اسم انتزاعی (زندگی، آموزش، سلامتی، طبیعت، عشق) the نمی‌گیرد.
The life of a soldier is hard.
The education I received was excellent.
The nature of the problem is clear.
Life is too short to worry.
زندگی کوتاه‌تر از آن است که غصه بخوری.
Health is more important than money.
وقتی بعدش of یا جمله‌ای می‌آید که آن را مشخص می‌کند، the لازم است: the history of Iran.
the rich یعنی «ثروتمندان». صفت -s نمی‌گیرد، ولی فعلش جمع است.
a / an با اسم غیرقابل شمارش وقتی توصیف دارد
She has a good knowledge of history.
زندگی به طور کلی ← بدون the.
آموزش به طور کلی ← بدون the.
q: ___ of this city is very long.
She has ___ good knowledge of French.
lessons.title: the پیشرفته (Life is short، the rich)
lessons.sum: اسم‌های کلی و انتزاعی (life، education) بدون the؛ the + صفت برای گروهی از آدم‌ها (the rich، the poor).

b: در فارسی می‌گوییم «روی چیزی تأکید کرد» یا «درباره‌ی سفرش گفت». این فعل‌های انگلیسی خودشان معنی حرف اضافه را دارند و مفعولشان مستقیم می‌آید.
The teacher emphasized the importance of practice.
معلم روی اهمیت تمرین تأکید کرد.
لطفاً با ایمیل با ما تماس بگیرید.
می‌توانی آن مرد را توصیف کنی؟
پنجاه نفر در جلسه شرکت کردند.
اسم‌ها فرق دارند: an emphasis on، a discussion about، contact with، a resemblance to.
There is a strong emphasis on grammar.
I have no contact with him now.
الان هیچ ارتباطی با او ندارم.
attend to یعنی «رسیدگی کردن»: The nurse attended to the patient. این درست است.
The teacher emphasized on the importance of practice.
The teacher emphasized the importance of practice.
She mentioned about her new job.
Please contact with us by email.
Can you describe about the man?
Many people attended to the meeting.
q: He ___ the need for more money.
You can ___ me at any time.
There is a strong ___ on safety.
The nurse ___ the injured man first.
lessons.title: فعل‌هایی که حرف اضافه نمی‌خواهند (emphasize، mention)
lessons.sum: emphasize، mention، contact، resemble، describe، attend و approach مستقیم مفعول می‌گیرند؛ فارسی «روی / درباره‌ی / با / به» را اضافه می‌کند.

b: در انگلیسی رسمی حرف اضافه قبل از whom (برای آدم) یا which (برای چیز) می‌آید. بعد از حرف اضافه who و that نمی‌آیند.
the man to whom I spoke
the house I grew up in
the house in which I grew up
the people with whom I work
This is the man to whom I spoke yesterday.
این همان مردی است که دیروز با او حرف زدم.
The house in which I grew up has been sold.
خانه‌ای که در آن بزرگ شدم فروخته شده.
She is someone for whom I have great respect.
کسی است که برایش احترام زیادی قائلم.
both of whom / most of which
«که هر دوشان / که بیشترشان»: بعد از ویرگول both / all / most / some / none + of whom (آدم) یا of which (چیز). اگر of them بگذاریم، دو جمله بدون ربط کنار هم می‌آیند.
I have two brothers, both of whom are doctors.
دو برادر دارم که هر دو پزشک‌اند.
She bought ten books, most of which were novels.
ده کتاب خرید که بیشترشان رمان بود.
We met many students, some of whom spoke English.
دانشجوهای زیادی دیدیم که بعضی‌شان انگلیسی حرف می‌زدند.
وقتی «که این ...» به کل جمله‌ی قبل برمی‌گردد، which می‌آید، نه what.
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
امتحان را قبول شد، و این همه را تعجب‌زده کرد.
The train was late, which meant we missed the film.
قطار دیر کرد و در نتیجه فیلم را از دست دادیم.
We visited Shiraz, where my mother was born.
به شیراز رفتیم، جایی که مادرم آنجا به دنیا آمده.
This is the man to who I spoke yesterday.
This is the man to whom I spoke yesterday.
This is the house in that I grew up.
This is the house in which I grew up.
I have two brothers, both of them are doctors.
I have two brothers, both of whom are doctors.
She bought ten books, most of them were novels.
She bought ten books, most of which were novels.
He passed the exam, what surprised everyone.
He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
q: The woman to ___ I gave the money has left.
This is the room in ___ he wrote his books.
I have three sisters, all of ___ live abroad.
He sent me some photos, none of ___ were clear.
She didn't call me, ___ made me angry.
The company for ___ he works is in Tehran.
We have two cars, one of ___ is very old.
The people with ___ I work are very kind.
lessons.title: whom، in which، both of whom
lessons.sum: حرف اضافه + whom / which، و some of whom / most of which، و which برای اشاره به کل جمله.

b: «هرچه بیشتر بخوانی، بیشتر یاد می‌گیری». در انگلیسی هر دو بخش با the شروع می‌شوند.
هرچه بیشتر بخوانی، بیشتر یاد می‌گیری
The more you read, the more you learn.
The older you get, the wiser you become.
The more you practise, the easier it gets.
هرچه بیشتر تمرین کنی، آسان‌تر می‌شود.
The less you sleep, the worse you feel.
هرچه کمتر بخوابی، حالت بدتر است.
«دو برابر بزرگ‌تر» = twice as big as. بعد از twice صفت برتر (bigger) با than نمی‌آید.
His house is twice as big as mine.
خانه‌اش دو برابر خانه‌ی من است.
This phone is three times as expensive as that one.
این گوشی سه برابر آن یکی قیمت دارد.
I earn half as much as my brother.
This film is far better than the book.
این فیلم خیلی بهتر از کتابش است.
She is by far the best student in the class.
با فاصله بهترین دانشجوی کلاس است.
The test was nowhere near as hard as I expected.
امتحان اصلاً به سختی‌ای که فکر می‌کردم نبود.
The more you read, more you learn.
The more you read, the more you learn.
The sooner we leave, better it is.
The sooner we leave, the better it is.
His house is twice bigger than mine.
His house is twice as big as mine.
This phone is twice more expensive than that one.
This phone is twice as expensive as that one.
She is as clever than her sister.
She is as clever as her sister.
q: The harder you work, ___ you will be.
___ you start, the sooner you'll finish.
This is ___ the best pizza I've ever had.
The film was ___ as good as the book.
He is ___ taller than his father.
The more I know him, ___ I like him.
lessons.title: مقایسه‌ی پیشرفته (the more ..., the better، twice as big as)
lessons.sum: the more ..., the more ...؛ twice / three times as ... as؛ و nowhere near، by far، a great deal.

b: در جمله‌ی مثبت می‌شود برای تأکید یا مخالفت do / does / did گذاشت. بعدش فعل ساده می‌آید، مثل سؤال و منفی.
I do like your new haircut.
واقعاً از مدل موی جدیدت خوشم می‌آید.
"You didn't call me." "I did call you, but you didn't answer."
This is the very book I wanted.
I don't like it at all.
He left at the very beginning of the film.
Do you have any money at all?
There is no reason whatsoever to worry.
on earth بعد از کلمه‌ی سؤالی تعجب یا عصبانیت را نشان می‌دهد. myself / yourself بعد از اسم یا آخر جمله یعنی «خودِ».
What on earth are you doing?
Why ever did you say that?
The president himself opened the building.
خود رئیس‌جمهور ساختمان را افتتاح کرد.
I did saw him at the party.
I did see him at the party.
q: I ___ like your house. It's lovely!
She does ___ you. She just doesn't show it.
I did ___ the door. I'm sure!
This is the ___ place where we first met.
lessons.title: تأکید (I do like it، the very، at all)
lessons.sum: do / does / did برای تأکید + فعل ساده، the very، at all و whatsoever، on earth، و myself برای «خودم».

b: کالوکیشن یعنی دو یا چند کلمه که اهل زبان همیشه با هم به کار می‌برند. از نظر گرامر «do a mistake» هیچ ایرادی ندارد، ولی هیچ انگلیسی‌زبانی این را نمی‌گوید؛ می‌گویند **make a mistake**.
در فارسی هم همین‌طور است: می‌گوییم «تصمیم گرفتن»، نه «تصمیم کردن». این‌ها را باید با هم یاد گرفت، نه کلمه‌به‌کلمه.
بهترین راه: هر لغت تازه را با کالوکیشن‌هایش حفظ کن. در کارت هر لغت (در «پرکاربرد»، «کلاس» و دفترچه) بخش «کالوکیشن‌ها» همین را نشان می‌دهد.
هر دو در فارسی «کردن» یا «انجام دادن» ترجمه می‌شوند. قاعده‌ی کلی: **make** برای ساختن و به وجود آوردن چیزی است؛ **do** برای کارها، وظیفه‌ها و فعالیت‌ها.
She makes a lot of money.
He does his homework after dinner.
بعد از شام تکلیفش را انجام می‌دهد.
Could you do me a favor?
این‌ها را هم فارسی‌زبان‌ها اغلب با make یا do می‌گویند:
I had a strange dream last night.
Take this medicine twice a day.
این دارو را روزی دو بار بخور.
Please pay attention to the teacher.
با truth، lie، story و joke فعل **tell** می‌آید. با hello، goodbye، sorry و thanks فعل **say** می‌آید. سؤال را **ask** می‌کنیم.
در فارسی «چراغ را باز کن» یا «تلویزیون را ببند» می‌گوییم، ولی در انگلیسی وسیله‌ی برقی را **turn on** و **turn off** می‌کنیم. open و close برای در و پنجره و کتاب است.
Turn off the TV and go to bed.
تلویزیون را خاموش کن و برو بخواب.
صفت‌ها هم کالوکیشن دارند. «باران شدید» در انگلیسی heavy rain است، نه strong rain؛ ولی «قهوه‌ی غلیظ» strong coffee است.
There was heavy traffic this morning.
He is a tall man with dark hair.
مردی قدبلند با موهای تیره است.
خود جنس expensive است، ولی قیمتش high است: This phone is expensive. / The price is high.
برای سفر و تعطیلات **go on** می‌آید: go on a trip، go on holiday، go on vacation. برای وسیله‌ی نقلیه **by** بدون a / the: by car، by bus، by train. دوچرخه را **ride** می‌کنیم، نه drive.
We went on a trip to Shiraz.
I go to work by bus.
I missed the bus this morning.
امروز صبح از اتوبوس جا ماندم.
She makes her homework every day.
She does her homework every day.
Can you make me a favor?
Can you do me a favor?
I saw a strange dream last night.
I had a strange dream last night.
I eat my medicine every morning.
I take my medicine every morning.
وسیله‌ی برقی ← turn on / turn off.
My small brother is a doctor.
My little brother is a doctor.
We went to a trip last summer.
We went on a trip last summer.
I go to work with car.
I go to work by car.
q: Let's ___ a photo of the sea.
It's dark. Please ___ on the light.
I had a ___ dream last night.
We stayed at home because of the ___ rain.
We are going ___ holiday next week.
Hurry up, or we'll ___ the train!
lessons.title: کالوکیشن: کلمه‌هایی که با هم می‌آیند (make a mistake، heavy rain)
lessons.sum: بعضی کلمه‌ها همیشه با هم می‌آیند؛ ترجمه‌ی کلمه‌به‌کلمه از فارسی اغلب غلط از آب درمی‌آید.
